services.desc: Anne Hirondelle (American, born 1944), Tumble 1, 2015, ceramic, 7 x 9 x 9 inches, collection of the Hallie Ford Museum of Art, Willamette University, Maribeth Collins Art Acquisition Fund, 2017.014. Photo: Dale Peterson. This exhibition is the first to feature Hallie Ford Museum of Art’s significant holdings of both historic and contemporary craft. On view are more than 60 artworks created in ceramics, textiles, glass, wood, and metal from well-known artists such as Rudy Autio, Frank Boyden, Dale Chihuly, Betty Feves, Heidi Preuss Grew, Linda Hutchins, Clay Lohman, George Rodriguez, Sara Siestreem, Ken Shores, Peter Voulkos, Patti Warashina, Marie Watt, Nancy Worden, and many more. services.name: School Tours
services.desc: If your group is larger than 30, you might consider rotating visits between the Hallie Ford Museum of Art and other Salem cultural institutions such as the State Capitol, located directly across from the Museum, or the Willamette Heritage Center at the Mill. With a printable Self-Guided Tour you and your class can find artworks in the Museum’s permanent collection galleries: spend some time looking and discussing each one, and learn more about art from the Pacific Northwest and around the world! (There are different levels of difficulty in the discussion questions, so do a little or a lot.) Metered parking for cars is available adjacent to the museum on State and on Cottage Streets.Free bus
